assessments.classification: Existing bounded nonfinding and source relationship, independently corroborated; no new count
assessments.evidence: Container parsing recognizes the opaque keyword and sets a flag; ReflectDerive::from_input returns Opaque before collecting struct/enum fields when the flag is selected. Opaque metadata requests type registration without field serialization/dependency data. Remote generator sets the declared Remote on metadata, emits a repr-transparent wrapper containing that Remote and exposes references to it. Registration emits ReflectFromPtr, optionally FromReflect and configured data.
assessments.current_connection: The 95e elapsed/fraction adapter source declares opaque reflect_remote of AnimationElapsed or UnitInterval and requests Serialize/Deserialize metadata. Their owner sources have private f32 fields, finite nonnegative or [0,1] checked constructors, and Serde try_from=f32 annotations backed by TryFrom source. Opaque selection, typed wrapper and constructor definitions do not prove an active feature, generated code, supported caller, all ingress paths or aggregate coherence.
assessments.safeguard_and_limits: In bevy_reflect 0.19.1, standard ReflectDeserialize::FromType<T> delegates to T::deserialize and boxes the result; the function field is public and custom construction is possible, so no universal dispatcher or callsite conclusion follows. Source itself does not prove that a supplied Remote is valid or that all mutable owner operations are safe.

assessments.evidence: The comma-list parser repeatedly consumes items. For Clone, Debug, PartialEq, PartialOrd and Hash, a custom function merges into current TraitImpl with conflict rejection, while the ordinary form directly overwrites it. For Hash the downstream get_hash_impl source produces different tokens for a custom callback and an ordinary implementation. A custom-then-ordinary duplicate can therefore replace the earlier selection in parser state, whereas the reverse order reaches the conflict branch. This is source reasoning, not macro execution.
assessments.condition: Requires an actually accepted enabled derive with duplicate entries in that order; semantic impact additionally requires generated code to compile and relevant reflected trait behavior to be used. Displayed 95e elapsed/fraction declarations and TacticalItemQuantity contain no such duplicate special-trait entries. This narrow inspection is not a whole-project absence search. Upstream duplicate-policy and a real first-party caller remain open.
